Question
========
Using the `diamonds` dataset, write R code that creates a scatterplot of `price` (y-axis) against `carat` (x-axis), and splits the plot into separate panels for each level of `cut` using `facet_wrap()`.


Solution
========
```
ggplot(data = diamonds, mapping = aes(x = carat, y = price)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ cut)
```

The base plot maps `carat` to x and `price` to y, and `geom_point()` renders it as a scatterplot. Adding `facet_wrap(~ cut)` then splits the single scatterplot into one panel per level of `cut`, each panel showing only the diamonds of that cut, but using the same x- and y-axis scales by default so the panels remain directly comparable.
